reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on the mechanics of troop movements in Provincia! In our upcoming patch, soldiers will no longer teleport or wheel through each other during attacks. Instead, they will slide into position based on their new facing, ensuring a more realistic and engaging gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Troop Movement Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We're implementing exciting changes to how troops move in Provincia! The new update will make soldiers slide into formation based on their facing, eliminating teleportation and creating a more authentic battlefield experience. Learn more about these changes and how they'll affect gameplay in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
